toolboxes.name: Financial Econometrics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Financial Econometrics Toolbox: volatility measurement, ARIMAX models, VAR/VECM systems, GARCH-type and regime switching models, time-series forecasting, and Bayesian asset-pricing factor models.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Economics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Economics Toolbox: business cycle filters, stochastic volatility macroeconomic models, DSGE models, heterogeneous-agent models, continuous-time macro-finance and game theory.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Epidemiology Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Epidemiology Toolbox: inference of epidemiological parameters, compartmental models (SIR, SIS, SEIR, SIRS, SEIRD) and universal differential equations for epidemics.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Learning and Practice Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Learning and Practice Toolbox: multiple-choice exercises whose data and answers Julia computes, on descriptive statistics, hypothesis tests and linear regression, and a panel to write new ones.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Mathematical Core Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Mathematical Core Toolbox: symbolic math, linear algebra, nonlinear systems, numerical differentiation and integration, and ordinary and partial differential equations.
toolboxes.author: Pollis
